title: El hombre en busca de sentido
description: Viktor Frankl relata su experiencia en los campos de concentración nazis y reflexiona sobre la búsqueda de sentido ante el sufrimiento. El testimonio se vincula con su propuesta de logoterapia y con la capacidad humana de responder a circunstancias extremas.

en.subtitle: An introduction to logotherapy
en.title: Man's Search for Meaning
en.description: Viktor Frankl recounts his experiences in Nazi concentration camps and reflects on the search for meaning amid suffering. His testimony connects with his approach to logotherapy and his examination of the human capacity to respond to extreme circumstances.
